changelog: CS3 Manager settings row now matches the host's own rows exactly: same 24dp icon with 16/8dp padding, same 16sp title, subtitle in normal text colour with the host's secondary alpha (0.78) instead of a separate gray, 56dp minimum height and a transparent row with the host ripple instead of a solid surface.

The row is placed directly below the last list entry instead of at the bottom of the screen. Its position is measured from Compose's own semantics tree, so it sits exactly under 'Extensions' / the build stamp on every screen size.
If the settings list actually needs scrolling, the row falls back to a reserved slot above the navigation bar so it never covers a list entry.
Host Inspector added earlier in this release line stays available under Settings > System.
